record.t: Was first elected to the Nevada Senate in November 2022 and has served since 2022.
Served on the Health and Human Services, Natural Resources, and Ways and Means committees in the 2021 session.
record.q: 2021 SESSION COMMITTEES: Health and Human Services; Natural Resources; Ways and Means

record.t: Served on the Health and Human Services; Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining; and Ways and Means committees in the 2019 session.
record.q: 2019 SESSION COMMITTEES: Health and Human Services; Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining; Ways and Means

record.t: Served on four interim bodies in 2019-2020, including the Interim Finance Committee and the interim wildfire study committee.
record.q: 2019-2020 INTERIM COMMITTEE: Committee to Conduct an Interim Study Concerning Wildfires; Interim Finance Committee; Legislative Committee on Health Care; Northern Regional Behavioral Health Policy Board

record.t: Served on the Health and Human Services; Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining; and Ways and Means committees in the 2017 session.
record.q: 2017 SESSION COMMITTEES: Health and Human Services; Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining; Ways and Means

record.t: Served as Chair of Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining and Vice Chair of Health and Human Services, and also sat on Ways and Means, in the 2015 session.
record.q: 2015 SESSION COMMITTEES: Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Mining (Chair); Health and Human Services (Vice Chair); Ways and Means

record.t: Served on the Interim Finance Committee and two other legislative oversight committees in 2015-2016.
record.q: 2015-2016 INTERIM COMMITTEES: Interim Finance Committee; Legislative Committee for the Review and Oversight of the Tahoe Regional Planning Agency and the Marlette Lake Water System; Legislative Committee on Public Lands

record.t: Served in the Nevada Assembly from 2015 to 2021, after first being elected in November 2014.
